name: Epigonus of Thessalonica
bio: Epigonus of Thessalonica is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors gives no firm date for the poet. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of the Wreath of Philippus, the Garland compiled in the first century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 261).

poems.title: Book IX, 261
poems.author: Epigonus of Thessalonica
poems.text: I, the vine who once was young and clothed in leafy shoots, I who bore bunches of swelling grapes, am now as old as you see. Look how Time overcomes us! Even the vine’s clusters know the wrinkles of old age.
